`abstract class RangeList<E>`<br/>
**Extends:** `AbstractList<E>`<br/>
**Implements:** `RandomAccess`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [RangeList.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/RangeList.java)

Read-only list of the options of a slider range, whose values are computed from their index instead of stored.

## Description

[`IntegerSliderNode`](/reference/controls/integerslidernode/) and [`DoubleSliderNode`](/reference/controls/doubleslidernode/) hold their range in one, so a range of millions of values costs nothing; `getValueList()` returns it.
`contains` and `indexOf` compute the index of a value instead of walking the list.
